arms.full: CNN + two-layer GNN with base-pair-probability-weighted pairing messages + three-context frozen RNA-FM + cell readout
arms.no_cnn: Zero local CNN feature score; retain its cell intercept
arms.no_gnn: Zero the GNN score; retain CNN structure channels and RNA-FM
arms.no_rnafm: Zero the RNA-FM score and its cell-conditioned correction
arms.no_rnafold: Zero CNN pairing channels and all graph pair messages; retain backbone GNN and RNA-FM
arms.no_cell: Use one common CNN intercept and no RNA-FM cell interaction
arms.no_cnn_structure: Zero only the two RNAfold-derived CNN channels; retain GNN pair messages
arms.no_gnn_pair: Zero only RNAfold-derived GNN pair messages; retain CNN structure channels and backbone GNN

thresholds: Recompute on that arm/refit's own C predictions only
initialization: All arms have identical state inventory and initialization at a given seed
capacity_caveat: Compute-then-zero removal is not a matched active-capacity control
structure_caveat: no_rnafold removes all explicit RNAfold inputs; no_cnn_structure and no_gnn_pair isolate its CNN-channel and GNN-pair paths. Frozen RNA-FM may retain implicit structural information.
intended_scope: Runnable experimental definitions; no empirical outcome is asserted
